title: GTA 6 Sent Ronaldo to the Gym One Too Many Times
caption: A GTA 6 gym trip has Ronaldo questioning who wrote the whole game. Wait for how fast his driving defense falls apart. #StableRonaldo #GTA6 #GTAVI #Gaming
pin: What in-game chore would make you quit the mission?
why: The storyline roast lands instantly, then Ronaldo spirals over another gym trip.
